glosses: series (a number of things that follow one another)
series (a television or radio program with several episodes)

examples.text: Ellos dieron una serie de conciertos.
examples.en: They gave a series of concerts.

examples.text: ¿Cual es tu serie de televisión favorita?
A las ocho empieza mi serie favorita.
examples.en: My favorite show starts at eight.

examples.text: Él acaba de publicar una interesante serie de artículos.
examples.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
